evals.name: standard-trigger
evals.prompt: validate experiments from the last 2 days
evals.expected_output: Audit table showing recent experiments (130a-134d) with gap categorization. Should identify: (1) v2 test results as MISSING_RESULTS for 120b/108a/99m_v2/133f, (2) oracle test results partially missing, (3) multiple experiments lacking reproducible scripts. Should stop at user approval gate.

assertions.text: Produces an audit table with at least 5 experiments
Identifies MISSING_RESULTS gaps for v2 test suite results
Stops at user approval gate before executing verifications
Uses QMD or grep to search research log (not reading full file)

evals.name: specific-concern
evals.prompt: I'm worried the v2 test suite results weren't saved to disk. check if all models we tested on v2 have summary.json files
evals.expected_output: Should check disk for v2 test results, find that no summary.json contains cross_cell_corr key, identify specific models (120b, 108a, 99m_v2, 133f) as missing v2 results, and propose re-running the v2 test suite with verification agent contract.

assertions.text: Checks disk for v2 test results (cross_cell_corr key or v2-specific paths)
Identifies that v2 results exist in research log but NOT on disk
Proposes verification tasks with reproducible scripts
Includes --no_ema flag in any proposed test commands
